photographs.title: Bharati Research Station under Aurora Australis
photographs.licence: Government of India Institutional Media (Educational use permitted)
photographs.description: Long-exposure night photograph of Bharati Base in the Larsemann Hills illuminated by green ribbons of the Southern Lights (Aurora Australis). Shows aerodynamic elevated modular architecture.

photographs.title: Maitri Station and Lake Priyadarshini in Polar Summer
photographs.description: Panoramic view of Maitri Base situated on the rocky permafrost ground of Schirmacher Oasis with the blue, ice-free waters of Lake Priyadarshini in the foreground.

photographs.title: Himadri Research Base at Ny-Ålesund Harbor
photographs.description: Exterior view of India's Arctic base Himadri flying the Indian flag, situated on the shores of Kongsfjorden with Kings Bay and glaciated peaks in the background.

photographs.title: Himansh High-Altitude Field Station in Chandra Basin
photographs.description: High-altitude containerized living shelter and 10-meter meteorological instrument mast surrounded by glaciated moraines in Chandra Basin (4,080 m ASL).

photographs.title: NASA Operation IceBridge Airborne Sea Ice Survey
photographs.description: High-altitude aerial photography documenting open leads, pressure ridges, and seasonal sea-ice deformation in the polar cryosphere.

videos.title: Seasonal Arctic Sea Ice Dynamics (Visualization Animation)
videos.source_owner: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
videos.description: Scientific time-lapse animation illustrating the annual cycle of Arctic sea-ice freezing and retreat, highlighting multi-year vs first-year ice extent.

videos.title: Deploying the IndARC Underwater Mooring in Kongsfjorden
videos.description: Field documentary showing deck operations on the research vessel in Kongsfjorden, showing rigging of acoustic releases, CTD sensors, fluorometers, and mooring anchor drop.

videos.title: The Green Base: Inside Bharati Station Antarctica
videos.description: Documentary overview of station life, cogeneration heat recovery, zero-discharge wastewater recycling, and satellite downlinks at Bharati base.
